items.title: Brainrot leaderboard
items.text: The top three collectors stand as statues on a podium in Skyhaven, just south-east of spawn. And when anyone catches a brainrot, everyone sees a card with them and it in 3D.

items.title: Brainrots!
items.text: Fifteen brainrots roam the survival world: Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala and friends. Right-click to catch them and press J for your album.

items.title: SkyRPG Builder
items.text: Builder Stations: load a village house or your own .litematic/.schem/.nbt, place its hologram, deliver the materials and watch it build itself from the ground up.

items.title: Setup screen clicks fixed
items.text: Buttons, presets and toggles in the welcome setup (and the spell wheel) respond to the mouse again.

items.title: Welcome screen, mods and shaders
items.text: A new title screen and first-time setup, Sodium + Iris shaders, Zoomify (hold C) and more comfort mods. The pack updates itself.

items.title: Fishing, waystones and tools
items.text: Bite cues and hotspots, one bait per catch, catches straight to your inventory. Waystones can be moved and renamed. Tools wear and get repaired; new Unbreakable enchant.

items.title: The Ender Wyrm awakens
items.text: Summon the final boss with a Void Sigil, earn Wyrmscale gear, the Voidreaver and 32 titles.
